module.description: Browse, tag and watch your Quake II demos.

planned.intro: A demo library is on the way: find, describe and play back every demo you've recorded.

highlight.1: Find every demo across installations and folders
highlight.2: See map, players and length before playing
highlight.3: Play and scrub a demo from the launcher
